content: Root cause: The bug was caused by returning the total time in microseconds instead of converting it to seconds when parsing time formats 'hh:mm:ss' and 'hh:mm:ss.ssssss'. The original implementation returned the raw microsecond value, which was incorrect for the expected output format. The patch corrects this by multiplying the return value by 1e-6 to convert microseconds to seconds before returning it.
